macroTarget.note: Trainer target for Jmo: fat loss, lean muscle gain, and metabolism support. Daily structure is 3 whole-food meals plus 1 high-protein snack.

dailyHabits: Hit 155-160g protein before worrying about perfection elsewhere.
Build meals from lean protein, approved carbohydrates, vegetables, and controlled healthy fats.
Use the 30g protein list for fast swaps when travel, kids, or work blow up the plan.
Log meals, workout, water, and weight once per day.

trackerDefaults.workoutGoal: Complete planned lift/cardio or active recovery

recipeLibrary.name: Greek Yogurt with Berries and Almonds
instructions: Combine Greek yogurt and berries in a bowl.
Top with chopped almonds.

recipeLibrary.name: Spinach and Feta Omelet
instructions: Cook spinach in olive oil until wilted.
Add beaten eggs, cook until set, add feta, and fold.

recipeLibrary.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Grill chicken until cooked through.
Build salad with vegetables, top with chicken, and drizzle vinaigrette.

recipeLibrary.name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Bake salmon and asparagus at 400F for 12-15 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

recipeLibrary.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp with Broccoli
instructions: Cook garlic and shrimp until pink.
Saute broccoli until tender.
Combine and finish with lemon.

recipeLibrary.name: Turkey Meatballs with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Bake turkey meatballs at 375F for 20-25 minutes.
Pulse cauliflower into rice and saute until tender.

recipeLibrary.name: Slow Cooker Chicken and Quinoa Casserole
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot.
Cook on low for 6-8 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Crockpot Turkey and Vegetable Chili
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Brown turkey.
Combine all ingredients in crockpot and cook on low for 6-8 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Slow Cooker Beef and Broccoli
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place beef and broccoli in crockpot.
Mix sauce separately, pour over, and cook on low for 5-7 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Crockpot Lemon Garlic Chicken
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place chicken in crockpot.
Pour lemon garlic mixture over chicken and cook on low for 4-6 hours.

meals.name: HT Chicken Quinoa Black Bean Bowls
meals.salePrice: Perdue Perfect Portions boneless chicken breast, 24 oz: $6.99 public NC ad through Sep 29; verify Belmont VIC/coupon
meals.protein: Boneless chicken tenderloins or chicken breast
meals.vegetable: Zucchini, bell peppers, romaine, tomatoes, and cucumbers
meals.dealHighlight: Leanest straightforward family option this week.
meals.macroFit: High-protein, moderate-carb dinner that fits the 2100-cal plan cleanly; use 1 cup cooked quinoa/beans combined and keep oil to 1 tbsp for the pan.

ingredients.name: Boneless chicken tenderloins or chicken breast

instructions: Season chicken with lemon, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; grill or skillet-cook until done.
Saute zucchini and peppers with measured oil until browned but still firm.
Warm quinoa and black beans, then divide into five measured bowls.
Top with chicken, vegetables, romaine, cucumbers, tomatoes, and salsa or lemon juice.

meals.name: HT Ground Chuck Burger Potato Plates
meals.salePrice: 80% lean ground chuck: $5.49/lb public NC ad through Sep 29; drain well and keep adult portions measured
meals.vegetable: Mushrooms, mixed greens, cucumbers, and tomatoes
meals.dealHighlight: Burger-night compromise that keeps protein high without donating half the fat budget to dinner.
meals.macroFit: Bunless plate keeps carbs useful; drain well, skip cheese, and make the rest of the day leaner.
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges and roast until crisp.
Form ground chuck into five patties, season, and grill or pan-sear; drain excess fat before serving.
Saute mushrooms separately and build a big salad with cucumbers and tomatoes.
Serve patties bunless with potatoes, mushrooms, pickles, mustard, and greens.

meals.name: HT Tuna Steak Sweet Potato Broccoli Plates
meals.salePrice: Wild-caught tuna steaks: $9.99/lb public NC ad through Sep 29; verify Belmont seafood case
meals.dealHighlight: Lean seafood night with protein to spare.
meals.macroFit: Tuna keeps fat lower than salmon; keep added oil modest and use the sweet potato as the main carb.
instructions: Roast cubed sweet potatoes until browned.
Season tuna with lemon, garlic, dill, and pepper, then sear or air fry just until cooked to preference.
Steam or roast broccoli with minimal added oil.
Serve with cucumber tomato salad and measured sweet potato portions.

meals.name: HT Argentine Shrimp Taco Rice Bowls
meals.salePrice: EZ-peel white shrimp, 21-30 ct.: $7.99/lb public NC ad through Sep 29; verify Belmont seafood case
meals.vegetable: Peppers, onions, romaine, salsa, and tomatoes
meals.dealHighlight: Fastest high-protein dinner on the board when the afternoon gets stupid.
meals.macroFit: Use measured rice and beans; Greek yogurt gives the sour-cream feel with extra protein and less fat.
instructions: Sauté shrimp with taco seasoning, peppers, and onions until just opaque.
Warm brown rice and pinto beans.
Build bowls with measured rice, beans, shrimp, romaine, salsa, and Greek yogurt.
Use lettuce bowls for anyone who wants a lower-carb version.

meals.name: ALDI Chicken Thigh Fajita Rice Bowls
meals.salePrice: Antibiotic-free boneless skinless chicken thighs: $2.49/lb regional public ad through Sep 29; Belmont availability and price may vary
meals.vegetable: Peppers, onions, romaine, tomatoes, and cucumber
meals.dealHighlight: Aldi value play; trim visible fat and measure oil so thigh meat does not hijack the day's fat target.
meals.macroFit: Beans make the bowls filling; Jmo gets a 5 oz cooked chicken portion and a measured rice scoop.
instructions: Season sliced chicken with chili powder, cumin, garlic, and lime; sauté with onion and peppers until cooked through.
Warm black beans and brown rice separately.
Build bowls with romaine, cucumber, chicken, beans, rice, and salsa or lime.
Keep Jmo's rice portion measured; let the kids add extra rice if needed.

meals.name: ALDI Center-Cut Pork Chop Potato Plates
meals.salePrice: Boneless center-cut pork chops: $3.99/lb regional public ad through Sep 29; verify Belmont package and price
meals.vegetable: Green beans, zucchini, and cabbage slaw
meals.dealHighlight: Budget-friendly leaner pork night with a simple 4 oz cooked adult portion.
meals.macroFit: Center-cut chops are the more controlled pork choice; use a measured sweet potato and go heavy on vegetables.
instructions: Season chops with garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper; pan-sear or air fry until cooked through.
Roast sweet potato wedges and steam green beans while the chops cook.
Toss cabbage slaw with vinegar and mustard; sauté zucchini if preferred.
Serve a 4 oz cooked chop portion with measured sweet potato and plenty of vegetables.
